definitions.explanation: A name given to someone based on their characteristics, appearance, or other features, often used among friends or classmates.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}のあだ{名|な}は「カズ」だ。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}、{変|へん}なあだ{名|な}をつけられた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was given a strange nickname.

notes:
The kanji forms {渾名|あだな} and {綽名|あだな} are rarely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あだ{名|な}をつける: to give a nickname
- あだ{名|な}で{呼|よ}ぶ: to call by a nickname
